subject: Argument for exclude/ignoring species for data imported from Excel

messages.author: 841d855a3af9d1fd
messages.subject: Argument for exclude/ignoring species for data imported from Excel
parts:
Dr. Niedballa,

Thank you for your assistance and direction!  I wanted to ask about incorporating an argument to exclude a species into the function when generating a recordTable (from using existing data imported from Excel).  I have included the error message below.  Please let me know if any additional information would be helpful.

> records_filter10_min <- assessTemporalIndependence(intable = records,
+                                                    deltaTimeComparedTo = "lastIndependentRecord",
+                                                    columnOfInterest = "Species",
+                                                    stationCol = "Station",
+                                                    cameraCol = "Camera",
+                                                    camerasIndependent = FALSE,
+                                                    minDeltaTime = 10,
+                                                    exclude = "Bird",
+                                                    eventSummaryColumn = "Count",
+                                                    eventSummaryFunction = "max"
+ )
Error in assessTemporalIndependence(intable = records, deltaTimeComparedTo = "lastIndependentRecord",  : 
  unused argument (exclude = "Bird")

Thank you, again,
-Michelle

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Argument for exclude/ignoring species for data imported from Excel
parts:
Hi Michelle,

The issue is that assessTemporalIndependence is an internal and undocumented (i.e., no help file) function in recordTable, which I only provided as a temporary fix for filtering existing record tables in this thread because there is no proper function to filter existing record tables yet. This is why not all arguments from recordTable work in assessTemporalIndependence
Some suggestions though:

- if you took the code for assessTemporalIndependence from the other thread here on the group, it may be a bit dated, has changed in the meantime, and is likely to change more in the future. If you use it, please use the most recent version, which you can access via camtrapR:::assessTemporalIndependence() or from github (on github may be development version not yet on CRAN, so I'd advise against it).
- to remove the birds in your example, I'd run assessTemporalIndependence without the exclude argument and remove birds afterwards.

records_filter10_min_no_birds <- records_filter10_min [!records_filter10_min$Species %in% "Bird", ]

Please let me know if there's further issues.
Best regards,
Jürgen
